title: Viet Template Language (VTL) Feature Claim Matrix
description: Authoritative inventory of claimed language features, intentional differences, and extensions for the Viet Template Technology Compatibility Kit (TCK).

features.name: Single-line comment
features.description: Lines or inline fragments starting with ## are treated as single-line comments and omitted from rendered output.

features.name: Multi-line block comment
features.description: Content enclosed within #* and *# is treated as a block comment and excluded from rendered output.

features.name: Reference backslash escaping
features.description: Backslashes preceding reference sigils escape variable rendering according to standard Velocity escaping rules.

features.name: Directive backslash escaping
features.description: Backslashes preceding directive keywords escape directive parsing and render keyword literally.

features.name: String literal quotes
features.description: Supports single-quoted uninterpreted string literals and double-quoted interpolated string literals.

features.name: Shorthand reference notation
features.description: Evaluates shorthand reference identifiers such as $user from the render context.

features.name: Formal reference notation
features.description: Evaluates formal reference identifiers delimited by braces such as ${user}.

features.name: Quiet shorthand reference
features.description: Suppresses output when reference evaluates to null using quiet notation $!user.

features.name: Quiet formal reference
features.description: Suppresses output when reference evaluates to null using quiet formal notation $!{user}.

features.name: Reference text concatenation
features.description: Concatenates formal reference with immediately adjacent literal suffix text without whitespace.

features.name: JavaBean getter property access
features.description: Resolves $bean.property to standard getProperty() getter method.

features.name: Boolean is-accessor property access
features.description: Resolves $bean.active to boolean isProperty() accessor method.

features.name: Record component property access
features.description: Resolves $record.component to Java record accessor component().

features.name: Map key property access
features.description: Resolves $map.key to Map.get('key') when receiver is java.util.Map.

features.name: Property lookup fallback order
features.description: Resolves properties using Velocity candidate ordering (getProp, GetProp, isProp, prop).

features.name: Array index access
features.description: Indexes into Java arrays with zero-based integer index syntax $arr[0].

features.name: List index access
features.description: Indexes into java.util.List instances with zero-based index syntax $list[1].

features.name: Map key index access
features.description: Accesses java.util.Map entries using bracket notation $map['key'].

features.name: Dynamic variable index access
features.description: Indexes collection or map using dynamic variable expression $arr[$idx].

features.name: Multi-dimensional nested index
features.description: Chains consecutive index brackets for nested collections $matrix[0][1].

features.name: Parameterless method call
features.description: Invokes public parameterless method on receiver object $obj.getName().

features.name: Single-argument method call
features.description: Invokes public method passing single argument expression $calc.doubleVal(5).

features.name: Multi-argument method call
features.description: Invokes public method passing multiple argument expressions $calc.add(3, 4).

features.name: Overloaded method resolution
features.description: Resolves overloaded method candidates by dynamic argument types.

features.name: Varargs method invocation
features.description: Invokes variable-arity method with variable number of arguments $calc.join('a', 'b').

features.name: Arithmetic operators
features.description: Evaluates standard arithmetic operators (+, -, *, /, %).

features.name: Relational comparison operators
features.description: Evaluates comparison operators (==, !=, <, <=, >, >=).

features.name: Logical boolean operators
features.description: Evaluates logical operators (&&, ||, !, and, or, not).

features.name: Integer range literal
features.description: Constructs ascending and descending integer range sequences [1..5].

features.name: Parenthesized expression grouping
features.description: Overrides operator precedence with parenthesized sub-expressions (a + b) * c.

features.name: Boolean literal truthiness
features.description: Evaluates boolean true as truthy and false as falsy.

features.name: Null truthiness
features.description: Evaluates null value or undefined reference as falsy in boolean context.

features.name: Number truthiness
features.description: Evaluates numeric zero (0) as falsy and non-zero numbers as truthy.

features.name: String truthiness
features.description: Evaluates empty string as falsy and non-empty string as truthy.

features.name: Collection and map truthiness
features.description: Evaluates empty collections and maps as falsy, non-empty as truthy.

features.name: Non-null object truthiness
features.description: Evaluates arbitrary non-null non-empty Java objects as truthy.

features.name: Scalar assignment
features.description: Assigns integer or string literal to template-scoped variable via #set.

features.name: Expression evaluation assignment
features.description: Assigns evaluated arithmetic or reference expression to variable via #set.

features.name: List literal assignment
features.description: Assigns list literal [1, 2, 3] to variable via #set.

features.name: Map literal assignment
features.description: Assigns map literal {'key': 'value'} to variable via #set.

features.name: Variable reassignment
features.description: Reassigns existing variable to new value within template execution scope.

features.name: Basic #if conditional
features.description: Executes template body conditionally based on boolean expression in #if.

features.name: #if and #else branches
features.description: Selects between truthy branch and #else fallback branch.

features.name: #if, #elseif and #else branches
features.description: Chains multiple conditional branches through #elseif directives.

features.name: Nested conditional directives
features.description: Evaluates nested #if conditions within outer conditional blocks.

features.name: List collection iteration
features.description: Iterates over java.util.List elements via #foreach($item in $list).

features.name: Array and range iteration
features.description: Iterates over Java arrays and integer range literals [1..3].

features.name: Loop index and count metadata
features.description: Exposes 0-based $foreach.index and 1-based $foreach.count loop metadata.

features.name: Loop boundary state metadata
features.description: Exposes $foreach.first, $foreach.last, and $foreach.hasNext loop state flags.

features.name: Early loop break directive
features.description: Terminates current loop execution immediately upon encountering #break.

features.name: Empty collection loop fallback
features.description: Executes #else branch when iterated collection is empty or null.

features.name: Parameterless velocimacro
features.description: Defines and invokes parameterless inline velocimacro via #macro(name) and #name().

features.name: Parameterized velocimacro
features.description: Defines and calls velocimacro with positional arguments #macro(greet $name).

features.name: Nested velocimacro invocation
features.description: Invokes a velocimacro from within the body of another velocimacro.

features.name: Recursive velocimacro invocation
features.description: Supports recursive macro invocations with base case termination.

features.name: Dynamic evaluation directive #evaluate
features.description: Evaluates dynamic VTL snippet string at runtime in VTL_DYNAMIC profile.

features.name: Dynamic property resolution
features.description: Resolves map or bean property with variable runtime key expression.

features.name: Polymorphic dynamic method dispatch
features.description: Dispatches method invocation on polymorphic interface receiver instance.

features.name: Tri-state quiet null suppression
features.description: Quiet reference notation $!nullVar renders empty string when receiver is null.

features.name: Unresolved reference literal rendering
features.description: Unresolved non-quiet reference renders literal source string $undefined.

features.name: Alternate default value expression
features.description: Provides fallback value expression when reference is null or missing ($val|'default').

features.name: Strict mode undefined variable check
features.description: Throws TemplateRenderException when undefined variable is accessed in strict mode.

features.name: Strict mode invalid property access check
features.description: Throws TemplateRenderException when non-existent property is accessed on target in strict mode.

features.name: Reflection denial on getClass
features.description: Denies access to getClass() and .class property by default with TemplateSecurityException.

features.name: ClassLoader and system pivot blocking
features.description: Blocks access to ClassLoader, Thread, Runtime, and ProcessBuilder targets.

features.name: Macro recursion depth limit
features.description: Terminates infinite or excessive macro recursion with TemplateLimitException.

features.name: Parse cycle and depth limit
features.description: Guards against infinite #parse cycles and recursion with TemplateLimitException.

features.name: Division by zero runtime error
features.description: Fails fast throwing TemplateRenderException with DIVISION_BY_ZERO diagnostic code.

features.name: Syntax error diagnosis
features.description: Reports malformed template syntax throwing TemplateSyntaxException with exact span coordinates.

features.name: Missing template resource error
features.description: Throws TemplateResourceException when referenced template resource cannot be resolved.

features.name: Vietnamese diacritic encoding
features.description: Correctly parses and renders UTF-8 Vietnamese accented characters (ă, â, đ, ê, ô, ơ, ư).

features.name: Multilingual CJK and non-Latin text
features.description: Preserves multibyte CJK, Arabic, and Cyrillic character encodings without corruption.

features.name: Emoji and surrogate pair rendering
features.description: Preserves supplementary plane characters and 4-byte UTF-8 emoji surrogates.

features.name: Static template composition #parse
features.description: Composes nested template by static name via #parse directive inheriting caller context.

features.name: Static raw resource inclusion #include
features.description: Includes raw non-evaluated resource text directly via #include directive.

features.name: RenderContext contributor merge
features.description: Merges external attributes into execution context via RenderContextContributor SPI.

features.name: Fail-fast division by zero
features.description: Viet Template fails fast with TemplateRenderException instead of producing null output on division by zero.
features.rationale: Silent arithmetic errors mask critical bugs in financial and billing templates; fail-fast ensures immediate defect discovery.

features.name: Default reflection and class access denial
features.description: Viet Template denies reflection access to getClass() and .class by default in standard execution.
features.rationale: Template injection vulnerabilities in Velocity frequently pivot through getClass() to achieve RCE; Viet Template is secure by default.

features.name: Legacy #set null RHS preservation option
features.description: Viet Template supports Velocity 1.x null RHS preservation where undefined RHS leaves variable untouched.
features.rationale: Many enterprise templates migrating from Velocity 1.7 rely on null RHS preservation for cascading defaults, which was removed in Velocity 2.x.

features.name: Programmatic loop termination via $foreach.stop()
features.description: Supports programmatic loop termination using $foreach.stop() method call on loop metadata.
features.rationale: Preserves backward compatibility with legacy enterprise templates utilizing programmatic loop termination.
